messages.text: Hi Sarah, If you look at the photos, the BS-4 comes in white or black.  But when you put it in your cart, it doesn't ask which color.  Is it only available in white?  or how would I order it in black if I want black?

Good catch — the listing only has one option, the AC plug. There's no colour choice at checkout, so I can't promise you black from the cart.

I've put that to Georges on our team to confirm what the current batch ships and whether black can be noted on an order. He'll pick it up right here and confirm by email, usually within a business day.
Handed to the team · No colour variant exists on the BS-4 listing; cannot confirm whether black is av

The team's been pinged and one of them will jump in here. If you step away, you'll get the answer by email.

Meanwhile — the BS-4 is $599.99, 18 TH/s at about 300 W, water-cooled and around 50 dB, and the page shows it shipping October 31, 2026. At 10¢ a kWh that's about $16 a month in power. What do you pay for electricity where it'd run?
